doc: Audio contract for the AudioDirector autoload. See docs/AUDIO_BIBLE.md. Generated: do not edit; change tools/audio/*.py and re-run.

S01.name: tap
S01.event: Any touch-down: UI control (UI bus) or world object (SFX bus)
S01.visual_twin: tint +6 L*, UI scale 0.96 in 80 ms / world squash 0.94

S02.name: collect
S02.event: Collect dew / a gift (each item of Collect all)
S02.trigger: per item as it lands on the counter
S02.caption: CAPTION_COLLECT
S02.visual_twin: gifts fly to the HUD, counter rolls 600 ms

S03.name: pet_purr
S03.event: Long-press / stroke a mossling (loops while held)
S03.trigger: at 450 ms hold; loops; 150 ms release
S03.caption: CAPTION_PURR
S03.visual_twin: radial fill, squash 0.88, hearts on release

S04.name: bud_unfurl
S04.event: Tap a ready bud (600 ms unfurl)
S04.caption: CAPTION_BLOOM

S05.name: plant_place
S05.event: Plant a flower / place a decor piece (incl. tutorial seed)
S05.trigger: when the seed lands / piece settles
S05.caption: CAPTION_PLANT
S05.visual_twin: seed arc 320 ms, soil puff / piece settles 500 ms

S06.name: water
S06.caption: CAPTION_SPLASH
S06.visual_twin: ripple ring to 36 dp in 380 ms

S07.name: sheet_open
S07.trigger: as the sheet starts to rise

S11.name: not_possible
S11.event: Not affordable / not possible (never a buzz)
S11.visual_twin: price chip pulse, +-2 dp wiggle (never red)

S12.name: creature_arrive_nap
S12.event: A mossling arrives (up a fifth) / curls up to nap (down)

S13.name: creature_chirp
S13.event: Tap a mossling (it turns to you and chirps)
S13.caption: CAPTION_CHIRP
S13.visual_twin: look-at, chirp bubble, name tag 2 s

S14.name: snore
S14.event: Tap a napping mossling (it stays asleep) / idle snore
S14.caption: CAPTION_SNORE

S16.name: postcard
S16.caption: CAPTION_POSTCARD
S16.visual_twin: mailbox flag pops up, wiggles every 8 s

S17.name: leaf_boat
S17.caption: CAPTION_BOAT
S17.visual_twin: boat launches at the spring rock

S18.name: bed_rustle
S18.event: Tap a bed with no ready buds

S20.name: lantern
S20.visual_twin: lantern brightens +60 % (200 ms in, 2 s hold, 1.2 s out), 2-3 fireflies released (Art Bible §6.6)

S21.name: wind_chime
S21.event: Tap the shell wind chime (falling run) / breeze gusts ring it
S21.caption: CAPTION_CHIME

S26.name: wish_appear
S26.event: A wish thought bubble rises over a friend (Active F1)
S26.caption: CAPTION_WISH

S27.name: wish_granted
S27.trigger: 120 ms after the fulfilling action's cue
S27.caption: CAPTION_WISH_GRANTED
S27.visual_twin: bubble pops into 5 petals, delight pose 900 ms

S28.name: petals_gathered
S28.event: Spare petals lift and arc to the tea nook (Active F2)
S28.caption: CAPTION_PETALS
S28.visual_twin: petals arc to the nook 600 ms, jar bobs

S29.name: pot_plip
S29.event: A petal or a drop falls into the pot (Active F2)
S29.caption: CAPTION_PLIP

S30.name: stir_bell
S30.event: Stirring: a felt bell every 180 degrees with a spoon swish (Active F2)
S30.caption: CAPTION_STIR

S31.name: pour
S31.trigger: as the pour starts (TICK at its end, played by the pot)
S31.caption: CAPTION_POUR
S31.visual_twin: pour arc 1.2 s into the cup

S32.name: cup_clink
S32.event: A cup is offered: two-cup clink and a soft sip (Active F2)
S32.caption: CAPTION_CLINK

S33.name: new_recipe
S33.event: A new recipe is found (Active F2)
S33.caption: CAPTION_RECIPE

S34.name: nook_steam
S34.event: Tea nook steam wisp (only while the nook is on screen; Active F2)
S34.caption: CAPTION_STEAM

S35.name: decor_lift
S35.event: A decor piece lifts (also take out of the tray; Active F3)
S35.caption: CAPTION_DECOR_LIFT

S36.name: decor_snap
S36.event: The carried piece enters a snap socket (<= 1 per 150 ms; Active F3)
S36.caption: CAPTION_DECOR_SNAP

S37.name: decor_turn
S37.event: Turn a decor piece one step (Active F3)
S37.caption: CAPTION_DECOR_TURN

S38.name: decor_tuck
S38.event: Tuck a decor piece into the tray (Active F3)
S38.trigger: as it shrinks into its tile
S38.caption: CAPTION_DECOR_TUCK
S38.visual_twin: piece shrinks into the tray tile, tile pops
